description: Stratégie québécoise d'économie d'eau potable 2019-2025 is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation. La Stratégie québécoise d’économie d’eau potable (la Stratégie) 2019-2025 comprend des outils plus complets permettant de dresser un meilleur portrait de l’utilisation de l’eau potable et du coût des services d’eau. De nouveaux indicateurs et des objectifs personnalisés ont été introduits pour tenir compte des particularités propres à chaque municipalité. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Ministère des Affaires municipales et de l'Habitation. Its tags are Eau potable, Fuite, SQEEP. It offers 42 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-11 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution (CC-BY 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
